subject.title: ci(release): add plugin npm artifact preflight

question: Should the hardened v2 plugin npm package evidence become a supported release-maintainer contract?
rationale: The implementation is technically coherent, but this protected maintainer PR creates durable release automation, route semantics, and evidence ownership near publication boundaries.

options.title: Land after exact-head checks
options.body: Accept the contract after all current-head release, security, Testbox, and CI checks complete successfully.

options.title: Split validation from publication
options.body: Move preflight into a dedicated trusted workflow if release owners prefer a smaller permanent audit boundary.

options.title: Decline the evidence contract
options.body: Keep the existing workflow if the operator value does not justify permanent schema and automation ownership.

recommendation.title: Land after exact-head checks
recommendation.body: Accept the contract after all current-head release, security, Testbox, and CI checks complete successfully.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main history ties this person most directly to the publication workflow and release orchestrator being extended.
